documents.full_text:
Alpha College of Engineering

Date: 22/11/2025

The Board of Directors
Alumni Association of India, Inc.
Alumni Connect India Private Limited

RE: Transfer of Athletic Scholarship Rights to Alumni Association of India

Dear Directors,

This document formally acknowledges and confirms the transfer of athletic scholarship rights from Alpha College of Engineering, 34, Udayavar Koil Street, Thirumazhisai, Poonamallee, Chennai - 600124, Tamil Nadu to the Alumni Association of India (AAI).

SCHOLARSHIP TRANSFER CONFIRMATION:

Legal Basis
Alpha College of Engineering, 34, Udayavar Koil Street, Thirumazhisai, Poonamallee, Chennai - 600124, Tamil Nadu hereby formally transfers to AAI the rights to recommend candidates for athletic scholarships as specified below.

Scholarship Quantity and Type
We confirm the transfer of the following scholarships for the academic year 2025-26:
1. Five Hundred (500) four-year Full Ride Scholarships
2. Five Hundred (500) four-year Half-Fee

Terms of Scholarships
Each scholarship entitles the recipient to a full four (4) academic years of support, contingent upon the student maintaining eligibility requirements as outlined in university policy.

Rollover Provision
If in any given academic year AAI does not award the total of Five Hundred (500) scholarships, the balance of remaining scholarships shall be rolled over into the pool of AAI scholarships for future use.

[Signature] Director, Physical Education and Sports, Alpha Arts and Science College, Chennai 600035

--- Page 2 ---

Alpha College of Engineering

Rights Conferred
This transfer grants AAI the following rights:
The right to recommend candidates for these scholarships
The right to utilize these scholarships as assets within AAI's operations
The right to include these scholarships in AAI's financial statements at fair market value

University Final Approval
We reiterate that all recommended scholarship candidates remain subject to final approval by the University, which maintains the absolute and final right to accept or reject any scholarship candidate at its sole discretion.

Annual Renewal
This transfer of scholarship rights shall recur annually for the duration of our Agreement, with a new set of Five Hundred (500) scholarships becoming available at the beginning of each academic year.

This document, along with the accompanying Valuation Letter, constitutes official recognition of the transfer of these scholarship rights to AAI as tangible assets for use.

Sincerely,
[Signature] (G. SURESH)
Signature:
Director, Physical Education and Sports, Alpha Arts and Science College, Chennai 600035

Full-Ride value per year equals the tuition fee (₹ 4,40,000) although room and board, books and other fees are listed as "Included" without amounts.

documents.full_text:
Alpha College of Engineering

Date: 22/11/2025

The Board of Directors
Alumni Association of India, Inc.
Alumni Connect India Private Limited

RE: Valuation of Athletic Scholarships Granted to Alumni Association of India

Dear Directors:

This letter serves to formally document and establish the fair market value of athletic scholarships granted by Alpha College of Engineering, 34, Udayavar Koil Street, Thirumazhisai, Poonamallee, Chennai - 600124, Tamil Nadu to Alumni Association of India (AAI).

Alpha College of Engineering, 34, Udayavar Koil Street, Thirumazhisai, Poonamallee, Chennai - 600124, Tamil Nadu hereby confirms the transfer and contribution of the following athletic scholarships to AAI for the academic year 2025-2026:

Scholarship Valuation
Five Hundred (500) Four-Year Full-Ride Scholarships
• Value per scholarship per year: ₹ 4,40,000
• Total annual value: ₹ 2,20,000,000
• Total four-year value: ₹ 8,80,000,000
Each Full-Ride Scholarship includes:
• Tuition fees: ₹ 4,40,000
• Room and board: Included
• Books and supplies: Included
• Other standard student fees: Included
Five Hundred (500) Four-Year Half-Fee Scholarships
• Value per scholarship per year: ₹ 2,20,000
• Total annual value: ₹ 1,10,000,000
• Total four-year value: ₹ 4,40,000,000
Each Half-Fee Scholarship includes:
• 50% of tuition fees: ₹ 2,20,000
• 50% of room and board: Included
• 50% of books and supplies: Included
• 50% of other standard student fees: Included

[Signature] Director, Physical Education and Sports, Alpha Arts and Science College, Chennai 600035

--- Page 4 ---

Alpha College of Engineering

Total Valuation of All Scholarships
• Combined annual value: ₹ 3,30,000,000
• Combined four-year value: ₹ 13,20,000,000

The valuations provided represent the fair market value of these scholarships based on our current fee structure for the academic year 2025-2026. These values are consistent with what we charge other students attending our institution and represent the actual economic benefit being transferred to AAI.

Any unused scholarships from the current academic year will be rolled over into the pool of AAI scholarships for the future.

We confirm that AAI has the right to recommend candidates for these scholarships, subject to final approval by the University, and that these scholarships constitute a tangible asset transferred to AAI for its use.

This valuation may be relied upon for accounting and financial reporting purposes by AAI and its auditors.

Sincerely,
[Signature] [G. SURESH]
Director, Physical Education and Sports, Alpha Arts and Science College, Chennai 600035
